web:ti-snvsbd5d-lm61460-gr5a.title: LM61460 3-V to 36-V, 6-A, Low EMI Synchronous Step-Down Converter, SNVSBD5D (revised July 2022)
web:ti-snvsbd5d-lm61460-gr5a.note: Re-read for the circuit values (complements READS-P row web:ti-snvsbd5d-lm61460). Table 6-1: 1 BIAS (to VOUT; ground it if VOUT is above 12 V; optional 0.1-1 uF), 2 VCC (1 uF to AGND), 3 AGND, 4 FB, 5 PGOOD (open drain), 6 RT (5.76-66.5 kOhm, do not float), 7 EN/SYNC (precision enable; sync on the rising edge, AC coupling allowed; synchronized operation is forced PWM), 8 VIN1, 9 PGND1, 10 SW, 11 PGND2, 12 VIN2, 13 RBOOT, 14 CBOOT (100 nF to SW). Section 8.3.2: keep RENT || RENB in the 100 kOhm range for sync, 3.3 V pulse through 1 nF, clock range 200 kHz-2.2 MHz. Eq. (2): RRT(kOhm) = (1/fSW(kHz) - 3.3e-5) x 1.346e4 (14.3 kOhm -> 913 kHz, arithmetic). Eq. (3): RFBB = RFBT / (VOUT/1 V - 1), RFBT 100 kOhm recommended (100k / 9.09k -> 12.00 V, arithmetic). Electrical characteristics: VEN rising 1.263 V, deviation -5/+5 %, hysteresis 24/28/32 % of VEN; IEN 2.3 nA. Section 9.2.2.3: Isat >= IL-HS; eq. (10) L >= 0.32 x VOUT/fSW near dropout. 9.2.2.5: >= 10 uF ceramic input, rated preferably twice VIN max, plus a 100 nF 50 V X7R at each VIN/PGND pair. 9.2.2.6: CBOOT 100 nF X7R >= 10 V. 9.2.2.7: RBOOT 100 Ohm gives about 2.7 ns SW rise and about 0.5 % less efficiency at 2 MHz. 9.2.2.8: CVCC 1 uF 16 V. Table 9-2 (1000 kHz rows, 3.3/5 V): CFF 4.7 pF, RFF 1 kOhm. Package drawings 4223976/H 06/2026: body 3.9-4.1 x 3.4-3.6 x 0.8-1.0 mm; land pattern and stencil transcribed in tools/make_footprints.py rjr0014a().
